name: run-fixture-gate
goal: A browser run started with a teardown gate keeps its own fixtures until its observer releases them, closes the gate or is gone; without a gate its teardown is unchanged

evidence: Test-only fixture lifetime handshake: a run given HARNESS_E2E_TEARDOWN_GATE keeps its fixtures after its tests until its observer releases, closes the gate or is gone. Unset, the teardown is unchanged. Only packages/reports/playwright.config.ts uses that teardown. Not claimed to fix the earlier full-run failure, whose cause stays unknown

test/run-gate.test.ts (sha 136e5822) with real processes owning real run directories and SYNTHETIC seeds. Against the exact original teardown (sha c34c23e0): 3 failed, own meta, media and build gone before release; the ungated control passed (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/red)

removeFixtures.ts waits at its gate on a Unix socket, then calls the unchanged closeE2eRun; test/support/runGate.ts holds the gate; browserRun forwards an optional gate; the concurrent case gates the shorter run, releases it after its state is kept, closes gates in afterAll. Same guard: 4 passed (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/green)

title: Gate both runs of the concurrent observer; release each only after what it must keep is seen
Close gates, end each owned child by its handle within a bound, then remove owned files
Read bounded whole lines on both sides, reject listen errors, repeat release and close safely
Rerun the unchanged behaviour guard: red on the original teardown, green on the corrected one

evidence: test/reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts (sha 39b65466): second, then first, started with a gate; first released after the two-history snapshot, second after the peer-retention checks. Same 10 expects, 60 repeats, 900 s. No overlap assertion. Not run in a browser: waits for a Root slot

test/support/gatedRuns.ts (sha 18382ed7) tracks gates, children and owned paths; cleanup closes gates, ends each child by its handle (stdin end or SIGTERM, SIGKILL after the bound), then removes files. run-gate-cleanup.test.ts: 3 passed, incl. an intentionally failed guard; reversed order fails (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round2/sensitivity/C1)

runGate.ts (sha 5b778c84) and removeFixtures.ts (sha 73e4b31e) act only on whole lines up to 4096 bytes; listen rejects and closes on error; release and close repeat safely. Split reads asserted on real Unix sockets: root 3 passed, reports 2 passed. Round-1 gate: EADDRINUSE hang, partial line taken (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round2/sensitivity/P0)

Unchanged guard set (run-gate.test.ts sha 08ea2730): in a throwaway copy with the exact original teardown (sha c34c23e0), 3 failed on missing meta, media and build, control passed; in the tree with sha 73e4b31e, 4 passed (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round2/red, work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round2/green)

title: Drop any line over 4096, whole or unfinished, before acting on it, at the gate and the teardown
Settle readiness, status, return and cleanup when a child fails to spawn or ends early
End the untracked bystander in a finally block, pass or fail
Replay the final guard set: red on the original teardown, green on the corrected one

evidence: runGate.ts eachLine and removeFixtures.ts releasedBy drop a whole line over 4096 before acting. New guards pass; against round-2 code only they fail: line read, release obeyed (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round3/regressions)

gatedRuns.ts settles on spawn error (no pid) or close; ready, status, returned reject with how it ended; SIGKILL only if running. run-gate-children.test.ts: real ENOENT spawn and early exits, 3 passed
run-gate-cleanup.test.ts: bystander untracked, killed by its handle and awaited in finally; unchanged assertion that it survives cleanup. 3 passed, no unhandled errors

Round-3 guard set (gatedRuns changed, run-gate.test.ts unchanged): copy with original teardown c34c23e0, 3 failed on missing meta/media/build, control passed; tree teardown 57bc71c8, 4 passed (work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round3/red, work/harness-remote-mobile/run-barrier-plan/implementation/round3/green)
